spec.rawSql:

            ORDER BY run_time DESC
            LIMIT 1
        )

        FROM latest

spec.description: Current VaR as a percentage of the 2 percent risk budget.
spec.title: VaR Budget Used

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
            symbol,
            option_type,
            strike,
            expiry_days,
            quantity,
            round(delta, 4) AS delta,
            round(gamma, 6) AS gamma,
            round(theta, 2) AS theta,
            round(vega, 2) AS vega,
            round(position_delta, 2) AS position_delta,
            round(position_theta, 2) AS position_theta,
            round(position_vega, 2) AS position_vega
        FROM option_greeks_results
        WHERE run_time = (SELECT max(run_time) FROM option_greeks_results)
        ORDER BY abs(position_vega) DESC

spec.description: Per-option Black-Scholes Greeks from the most recent cloud run.
spec.title: Latest Option Greeks

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
            run_time AS time,
            hist_var_inr AS VaR,
            hist_cvar_inr AS CVaR,
            hist_cvar_inr - hist_var_inr AS Tail_Gap
        FROM var_results
        ORDER BY time

spec.description: Compares the VaR threshold with expected shortfall beyond that threshold.
spec.title: VaR vs CVaR Tail Gap

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
            a.symbol AS stock_a,
            b.symbol AS stock_b,
            round(corr(a.returns, b.returns), 3) AS correlation
        FROM market_ticks a
        INNER JOIN market_ticks b ON a.date = b.date AND a.symbol < b.symbol
        WHERE a.symbol IN (
            SELECT symbol
            FROM portfolio_positions
            ORDER BY quantity * price DESC
            LIMIT 8
        )
        AND b.symbol IN (
            SELECT symbol
            FROM portfolio_positions
            ORDER BY quantity * price DESC
            LIMIT 8
        )
        GROUP BY stock_a, stock_b
        ORDER BY abs(correlation) DESC
        LIMIT 25

spec.title: Correlation Radar

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
            breach_time,
            method,
            round(var_amount, 2) AS current_value,
            round(limit_amount, 2) AS limit_value,
            round(breach_pct * 100, 1) AS pct_of_limit,
            severity
        FROM breach_log

spec.description: Permanent regulatory-style event log for limit breaches.
spec.title: Breach Log

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM var_results
            ORDER BY run_time DESC
            LIMIT 1
        )
        SELECT 'VaR Budget' AS metric,
               round(hist_var_inr / (portfolio_value * 0.02) * 100, 2) AS used_pct,
               round(hist_var_inr, 2) AS current_value,
               round(portfolio_value * 0.02, 2) AS limit_value,
               if(used_pct >= 100, 'BREACH', if(used_pct >= 80, 'WARNING', 'OK')) AS status
        FROM latest
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'CVaR Budget',
               round(hist_cvar_inr / (portfolio_value * 0.03) * 100, 2) AS used_pct,
               round(hist_cvar_inr, 2),
               round(portfolio_value * 0.03, 2),
               if(used_pct >= 100, 'BREACH', if(used_pct >= 80, 'WARNING', 'OK'))
        FROM latest
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Delta',
               round(abs(net_delta) / 50 * 100, 2) AS used_pct,
               round(net_delta, 2),
               50,
               if(used_pct >= 100, 'BREACH', if(used_pct >= 80, 'WARNING', 'OK'))
        FROM latest
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Theta',
               round(abs(net_theta) / 500 * 100, 2) AS used_pct,
               round(net_theta, 2),
               500,
               if(used_pct >= 100, 'BREACH', if(used_pct >= 80, 'WARNING', 'OK'))
        FROM latest
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Vega',
               round(abs(net_vega) / 2000 * 100, 2) AS used_pct,
               round(net_vega, 2),
               2000,
               if(used_pct >= 100, 'BREACH', if(used_pct >= 80, 'WARNING', 'OK'))
        FROM latest
        ORDER BY used_pct DESC

spec.description: Shows recruiters that the cloud pipeline is refreshing data and risk outputs.
spec.title: Data Freshness

spec.rawSql:
WITH weights AS (
            SELECT symbol, quantity
            FROM portfolio_positions
        )
        SELECT
            date AS time,
            sum(close * quantity) AS portfolio_value
        FROM market_ticks
        INNER JOIN weights USING symbol
        GROUP BY date
        ORDER BY time

spec.description: Reconstructs portfolio value across the full historical window.
spec.title: Portfolio Value Replay

spec.rawSql:
WITH weights AS (
    SELECT
        p.symbol,
        p.quantity,
        p.quantity * m.latest_price AS position_value
    FROM portfolio_positions p
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT symbol, argMax(close, date) AS latest_price
        FROM market_ticks
        GROUP BY symbol
    ) m ON p.symbol = m.symbol
),
total AS (
    SELECT sum(position_value) AS total_value
    FROM weights
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        m.date,
        sum(m.returns * w.position_value / t.total_value) AS portfolio_return
    FROM market_ticks m
    INNER JOIN weights w ON m.symbol = w.symbol
    CROSS JOIN total t
    GROUP BY m.date
)
SELECT
    date AS time,
    round(stddevPop(portfolio_return) OVER (
        ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) * sqrt(252) * 100, 2) AS rolling_vol_60d_pct,
    round(1.645 * stddevPop(portfolio_return) OVER (
        ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) * 100, 2) AS rolling_var_60d_pct
FROM daily
ORDER BY time

spec.description: 60-day rolling volatility and 95 percent VaR. This creates a real curve, not a flat monitor line.
spec.title: Rolling Portfolio Risk

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    pp.sector,
    round(sum(pp.quantity * mt.close), 2) AS exposure_inr
FROM portfolio_positions pp
JOIN (
    SELECT symbol, close
    FROM market_ticks
    WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM market_ticks)
) mt ON pp.symbol = mt.symbol
GROUP BY pp.sector
ORDER BY exposure_inr DESC

spec.description: Exposure concentration across banking, IT, energy, consumer and pharma.
spec.title: Sector Allocation

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    p.symbol,
    p.sector,
    round(p.quantity * argMax(m.close, m.date), 2) AS exposure_inr,
    round(stddevPop(m.returns) * sqrt(252) * 100, 2) AS annual_vol_pct,
    round((p.quantity * argMax(m.close, m.date)) * stddevPop(m.returns) * sqrt(252), 2) AS risk_score
FROM portfolio_positions p
INNER JOIN market_ticks m ON p.symbol = m.symbol
GROUP BY p.symbol, p.sector, p.quantity
ORDER BY risk_score DESC
LIMIT 10

spec.description: Ranks positions by exposure times annualized volatility.
spec.title: Top Risk Contributors

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest_prices AS (
    SELECT symbol, argMax(close, date) AS latest_close
    FROM market_ticks
    GROUP BY symbol
),
position_values AS (
    SELECT p.symbol, p.quantity * lp.latest_close AS position_value
    FROM portfolio_positions p
    INNER JOIN latest_prices lp ON p.symbol = lp.symbol
)
SELECT
    round(portfolio_return * 100, 1) AS daily_return_bucket_pct,
    count() AS frequency
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.date,
        sum(m.returns * w.position_value / t.total_value) AS portfolio_return
    FROM market_ticks m
    INNER JOIN position_values AS w ON m.symbol = w.symbol
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT sum(position_value) AS total_value FROM position_values) AS t
    GROUP BY m.date
) AS daily
GROUP BY daily_return_bucket_pct
ORDER BY daily_return_bucket_pct

spec.description: Shows the empirical distribution that drives Historical VaR and CVaR.
spec.title: Portfolio Return Distribution

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  m.symbol,
  any(p.sector) AS sector,
  round(any(p.quantity) * argMax(m.close, m.date), 2) AS exposure_inr,
  round((stddevPop(m.returns) * sqrt(252)) * 100, 2) AS annual_vol_pct,
  round((avg(m.returns) * 252) * 100, 2) AS annual_return_pct,
  round(min(m.returns) * 100, 2) AS worst_day_pct
FROM market_ticks AS m
INNER JOIN portfolio_positions AS p ON m.symbol = p.symbol
GROUP BY m.symbol
ORDER BY annual_vol_pct DESC
